caseName: FAIRVIEW PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT NUMBER ONE v. City of Anchorage
caseNameFull: FAIRVIEW PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT NUMBER ONE Et Al. v. CITY OF ANCHORAGE
attorneys: George E. C. Hayes for appellants., Charles S. Rhyne for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Goldberg took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
